NAMESILO_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: NAMESILO_POLLING_INTERVAL
NAMESILO_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 2)

NAMESILO_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: NAMESILO_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
NAMESILO_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 60), it is better to set larger than 15 minutes

NAMESILO_TTL.title: NAMESILO_TTL
NAMESILO_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 3600), should be in [3600, 2592000]
